_comment: Per-signal corrections, applied as displayed = raw × scale + offset (canonical units). Use this when a reading is consistently off, e.g. vehicle speed on tires that differ from the size programmed into the PCM: scale = true speed ÷ reported speed, measured as described in docs/diagnostics/CALIBRATION.md. Changes only what the head unit shows and records; nothing is written to the truck. Allowed scale range: 0.5–2.0.

speed.note: Not measured yet: set from a GPS comparison (docs/diagnostics/CALIBRATION.md).
